# Held-out exercises for shared-state, written without reading the skill text.

# What is owed to the bus has to be recorded in the same transaction as the order.
# Retrying in process dies with the process, and publishing first announces orders
# that were never saved.
[order-outbox] some orders are saved but the warehouse never hears about them when the process dies or the broker is down during checkout, fix it so every saved order is announced | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# A reader that loaded the old row can store it after the writer has cleared the key.
# Reordering the delete narrows that and a lock in one process cannot close it.
[stale-fill] after a user renames themselves some pages keep showing the old name until the cache is flushed, fix it | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"
